name: EPIC 211914760
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 5.2 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 211914760 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.226361 (16th-84th percentiles 5.026387-5.442034), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,323 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.97 solar masses and 5.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,882 K at its surface.
